description: This file defines the singleton object OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction containing utility functions for extracting, sanitizing, formatting, and dispatching UI actions related to the canvas component in an Android app.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction
classes.description: Singleton object providing utility functions for handling UI actions.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the action name from a JSON object, attempting to retrieve 'name' or 'action' fields.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string value to be used as a tag by trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and replacing invalid characters with underscores.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Constructs a formatted string representing an agent message with various sanitized parameters.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript snippet to dispatch a custom event indicating the status of a UI action.

methods.name: jsonStringLiteral
methods.description: Converts a string into a JSON-compatible string literal, escaping specific Unicode characters.
